notes: Presentation, language and format instructions that a learner request (or the router that rewrites it) appends to a mathematical claim, for example 'Write the proposition and the entire proof in English.' The independent proof review judges the mathematical claim only, so these instructions are removed from its input by a closed set of patterns; the explanation stage still receives the full request. A method the learner requires (epsilon-delta, induction, ...) is part of the claim and is never in this table. Patterns are regular expressions (case-insensitive); {LANG_EN} and {LANG_CJK} expand to the language names below. To widen the table add a language name or a pattern row; no code change is needed. A row may set join (default a space): the text put where the match was removed; Japanese and Chinese rows use an empty join so no stray space is left between characters.
